E8_mod2_source.interpretation: The canonical mod-2 PSp action preserves the plus-type E8 quadratic space; any characteristic-zero root-span lift has dimension eight.

Hom_obstruction.naive_E6_plus_A2_route: The 6+2 root-span decomposition is reducible and does not evade the same irreducible-target obstruction.
Hom_obstruction.proof_8_to_90: A nonzero map into irreducible 90 has image 90, impossible from an 8-dimensional source.
Hom_obstruction.proof_90_to_8: A nonzero map from irreducible 90 has zero kernel and would inject 90 into dimension 8, impossible.

boundary: Restrictions to proper common subgroups, nonlinear covariants, tensor powers, correspondences through larger carriers, and deliberately symmetry-breaking injections remain open.

relation_to_pass1954.resolution: Pass 1954 allowed a noncanonical C6-linear embedding of primitive characters. Adding full PSp equivariance forces the Hom space to vanish.

theorem: There is no nonzero full-PSp-equivariant linear map in either direction between any eight-dimensional E8 root-span lift of the canonical mod-2 action and the irreducible coexact signed-edge 90. The formerly open canonical linear E8-to-coexact question is therefore closed negatively at full PSp symmetry.
